description.narrative: The purpose of this activity is to streamline integrated health services to more efficiently increase the survival and well-being of vulnerable populations and to improve health system performance in select districts. The activity will combine the family health and health systems strengthening activities currently implemented by regional health integration to enhance services (RHITES) activities into just one new activity.
